subject: Pilot economics — runway, target $/1M tokens and temporary credit
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex@studioforge.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@studioforge.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for the demo — few questions on costs + credits

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning — the latency and cost controls looked great. Priya and I discussed internally and want to make sure we are aligned on a reasonable pilot window. A couple of quick items we need before we go wide in the next two weeks: 

- Confirmation on expected unit economics for our workload: we estimated ~3-4M tokens/month during the initial ramp (mostly generation + some embeddings). Can you confirm an expected $/1M tokens range for the recommended model variant?
- Can Redwood provide a short runway (credits) to cover burst traffic during the first 10 business days while we stabilize caching/batching?
- Any guardrails we should implement on our side to avoid runaway spend?

Attaching a tiny usage snapshot from our staging run (pilot_usage_snapshot.csv) to give you a feel for sequence lengths.

Appreciate a quick post-call recap and next steps. We’re aiming to start the pilot on May 3.

—Alex
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex@studioforge.ai>, Priya Singh <priya@studioforge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — few questions on costs + credits

Hi Alex / Priya — great to chat today. Quick recap + practical next steps below.

Post-call recap (short):
- Redwood recommended model variant: rwd-llama-large-quantized (good balance of latency/cost for your mix).
- Expected pilot volume: your 3–4M tokens/month is consistent with what we saw in the snapshot.
- Target unit economics: for the rwd-llama-large-quantized variant we generally see $900–$1,100 per 1M tokens across production-ish loads with our batching/caching defaults; in very optimized setups that goes down further. For your early pilot we should budget toward the conservative side: plan $1,100 / 1M tokens.

Credit/top-up proposal (what I can offer quickly):
- Redwood can approve a temporary pilot credit covering ~300k tokens (equivalent to ~$330 at the $1,100/1M rate) to smooth the first 10 business days while you enable prefix caching and KV reuse.
- If you need a larger runway, we can provision an additional 200k tokens conditional on a quick usage guardrails checklist and a brief weekly burn report.

Recommended guardrails (engineering/dev):
- Hard cap: set a per-route token cap for the pilot (we recommend 40k tokens/day aggregate to start).
- Rate limits: throttle unseen heavy-generation routes (e.g., batch size limiter + concurrency gate).
- Monitoring: send a daily small CSV (same shape as the attachment) to this thread for the first 5 days.

Next steps / owners: 
- Ben: put 300k token credit on your account and share usage dashboard link (today EOD).
- Marissa (copied): will approve the additional 200k top-up if required; can you confirm?
- Camila: quick ops note — will send the guardrails checklist and a lightweight dashboard template.
- Alex / Priya: confirm pilot start date (May 3) and whether the 300k covers your initial ramp.

I attached a simple econ model for transparency (pilot_econ_model.xlsx).

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124

Subject: Re: Pilot economics — runway, target $/1M tokens and temporary credit

Ben — approved.

I’m OK to authorize the 300k token pilot credit now and the conditional +200k if they meet the guardrails and provide the 3-day rolling burn reports. Please add a short approval note in the ticket.

Also loop Rishi for any retention/audit concerns (he has been running the pilot playbook).

Marissa Cole

Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot economics — runway, target $/1M tokens and temporary credit

Ben / Marissa / Camila / Rishi — thank you, this is perfect. We accept the 300k token credit and will request the conditional +200k only if we hit the cap and can demonstrate the guardrails.

Quick confirmations:
- Pilot start: May 3 (we’ll switch DNS routing and start sending traffic at 09:00 PT).
- Budget plan: we will budget $1,100 / 1M tokens for planning, but will monitor daily and reach out if we see sustained higher consumption.
- DocuSign: can you send a short amendment (pilot top-up) so our procurement team has a paper trail? We need a signed note before the conditional top-up is applied.

I’ll upload the first-day staging traces and the CSV tomorrow morning. Thanks again for the quick turnaround.

—Alex
